body:
If we breakpoint where Nil property selectors get instantiated

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ba3482926daa6450d21b030cfe029689525c0e51/editor/editor_properties.cpp#L3537-L3545

it seems like the type for the value is being  #considered as `NIL`, rather than using the type encoded in the hint text.

An easy way to work around this seems to be to add a check in the case for `Variant::NIL` to see if the `p_hint` is a resource type or a node type, and then instead return the result of the function with `Variant::OBJECT` passed in as the `p_type` instead. This gets you a result like this where the value is `<empty>` and is editable, which seems more desirable.
